mechanism: Information-flow management for paper-to-codebase synthesis: blueprint compression, stateful code memory, retrieval of reference code, closed-loop verification
evidence_scope: a stateful Code Memory (CodeMem) that performs structured indexing of the evolving codebase to maintain cross-file consistency, and a CodeRAG system that performs conditional knowledge injection to bridge implicit domain gaps with standard implementation patterns.
evidence_role: we introduce DeepCode, a fully autonomous framework that fundamentally addresses this challenge through principled information-flow management.
